import sys, json, time, pathlib, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from prepare_env import ensure_environment
from dev_runner import PublicRunner
site=ensure_environment()
data=open('/tmp/max.json','rb').read()
print('bytes', len(data))
with PublicRunner(pathlib.Path('submission'), None, site=site) as sb:
    t=time.time()
    r=sb.invoke(data, timeout=180)
    print('rc', r.returncode, 'wall %.2f' % r.seconds, 'runner %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
    print('stdout', len(r.stdout), 'stderr', len(r.stderr), r.stderr[:500])
    out=json.loads(r.stdout)
    print('keys', list(out))
    for c in out['catalog']:
        print(c['id'], 'frags', len(c['fragments']), 'clusters', len(c['clusters']), 'kept', len(c['priority']), 'entries', c['entries'], 'nodes', len(c['backup']))
    print('installs', len(out['installs']), 'decisions', len(out['decisions']))
    import collections
    print(collections.Counter(d['reason'] for d in out['decisions']))
    print(collections.Counter(i['status'] for i in out['installs']))
    print('final', out['final'])
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('child maxrss MB', ru.ru_maxrss/1024, 'utime', ru.ru_utime, 'stime', ru.ru_stime)
EOF
